definition: Overconfidence is a cognitive and behavioral bias in which a person’s confidence judgment is excessively high, such as overstating their own abilities or knowledge. It differs from ordinary confidence, which is trust in something, because overconfidence reflects an inaccurate and inflated self-assessment.
